name: Ahmed I
role: Sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1603 to 1617
contribution: The sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1603 until his death in 1617.
legacy: This person's reign is noteworthy for marking the first breach in the Ottoman tradition of royal fratricide; henceforth, Ottoman rulers would no longer systematically execute their brothers upon accession to the throne

checks.lead: Ahmed I (Ottoman Turkish: احمد اول Aḥmed-i evvel; Turkish: I. Ahmed; 18 April 1590 – 22 November 1617) was the sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1603 until his death in 1617.
